items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: He called Mrs. So-and-so, Mrs. Robert, or Mrs. Joan, or Mrs. Williams, and Mr. Williams.

ctx.x: That's right. Man, that's a wonderful thing to see. What was the idea of them marching around the hall like that?

Well, the idea, I'll tell you. You see, that's when they call it a call out. They be calling out the members for the guests. First, what they do, all members is taking part in a dance. If you've lost the organization, they got a man with a book. He called Mrs. So-and-so, Mrs. Robert, or Mrs. Joan, or Mrs. Williams, and Mr. Williams. Well, the ladies, there's 20 ladies or 20 men, or four of them and four of the ladies. The ladies stand on one side. What you take and do, when they call your name, they call the…
Does all these lodges do that?
